# lmw notify send

Send a notification of yours

```
lmw notify send TEXT [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw notify send "Backup finished" --to phone
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help           help for send
      --title string   the title (default: lmw)
      --to string      the channel (default: all of them)
      --url string     a link to open
```
